tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH per_year AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         SUM(Total) AS total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY year
), max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total) AS max_total FROM per_year
)
SELECT p.year,
       ROUND(p.total,2) AS total,
       ROUND(COALESCE(p.total - prev.total, p.total),2) AS diff_from_prev,
       CASE WHEN prev.total IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((p.total - prev.total)/prev.total*100,2) END AS pct_change_from_prev,
       ROUND(prev.total,2) AS prev_total
FROM per_year p
LEFT JOIN per_year prev ON prev.year = p.year - 1
JOIN max_total m ON p.total = m.max_total
ORDER BY p.year;"}
